chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has already performed it.
So if he prays it a second time before having prayed it (properly/completed it), he must repeat it.
ai.seo_question: When must a Muslim repeat their prayer if they pray it twice?
ai.summary: This ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the principle of *Taqaddum* (precedence) in ritual acts, ensuring that the validity of the initial prayer is not compromised by premature repetition. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the integrity of the *Salat* structure, where a new act invalidates the previous one if the conditions for completion (*Tamam*) are not yet met. This distinction is crucial for understanding the nuances of *Salat al-Tawqifi* and the precise timing of ritual obligations.
